operations.summary: Read whether the console behind a CDN gets the visitor address (source IP header, origin authentication)
operations.summary_zh: 读取主控在 CDN 后是否已取得访客 IP（源IP请求头 / 回源鉴权状态）
operations.description: Requires system_configuration.read on the platform scope. Two separate observations of the answering control-api process, kept in its memory for an hour; no header value is stored. A CDN clue is a header CDNs write the visitor address into (CF-Connecting-IP, True-Client-IP, Ali-Cdn-Real-Ip, EO-Connecting-IP, Fastly-Client-IP, Cdn-Src-Ip), which the console nginx passes through. The visitor address is confirmed when the source IP header of the system other settings (source_ip_header) gave a valid address for the request, or when the console nginx with origin authentication (install-control.sh origin-auth --real-ip-header H, the CDN sending X-Cdnca-Origin-Key) sets X-Cdnca-Origin-Verified to 1, meaning the key matched and H gave the visitor address (key_only: the key matched, H did not; 0: no key); that header is believed only while the installer's /etc/cdnca-control/origin-auth.conf exists, since without origin authentication nginx passes a client's own through. cdn_without_origin_auth is true while the last CDN request without a confirmed visitor address came within the hour and no confirmed request came since.

responses.description: The observation of the answering process.

fields.name: cdn_without_origin_auth
fields.description: A CDN request without a confirmed visitor address came within the last hour and no confirmed one since.

fields.name: origin_auth_enabled
fields.description: install-control.sh origin-auth is configured on this host (its origin-auth.conf exists).

fields.name: baota
fields.description: A BaoTa host (the installer's host profile says ENV=bt), whose site proxy rewrites X-Real-IP and X-Forwarded-For with the CDN node: the source IP header reads only CF-Connecting-IP or True-Client-IP there.

fields.name: client_headers_forwarded
fields.description: The console nginx passes the client's own X-Real-IP and X-Forwarded-For to control-api as X-Cdnca-Client-X-Real-IP and X-Cdnca-Client-X-Forwarded-For (current installs and converged consoles), so the source IP header can read those two.

fields.name: real_ip_header
fields.description: The --real-ip-header origin authentication takes the visitor address from; empty while it is off.

fields.name: key_only
fields.description: The last CDN request without a confirmed visitor address carried the origin key but real_ip_header held no visitor address (X-Cdnca-Origin-Verified key_only): the CDN does not write the visitor IP into that header.

fields.name: visitor_ip_confirmed
fields.description: Within the last hour a request's visitor address was confirmed (by the source IP header or the origin key) and no unconfirmed CDN request came since.

fields.name: header
fields.type: string:  / CF-Connecting-IP / True-Client-IP / Ali-Cdn-Real-Ip / EO-Connecting-IP / Fastly-Client-IP / Cdn-Src-Ip
fields.description: The visitor address header of the last CDN request without a confirmed visitor address; empty when none came.

fields.name: last_seen_at
fields.description: When that request came; null when none came.

fields.name: last_confirmed_at
fields.description: When the last request with a confirmed visitor address came; null when none came.

responses.description: Authentication failed or the session is invalid.
responses.description_zh: 认证失败或会话已失效。

responses.description: The authenticated principal is not allowed to perform the action.
responses.description_zh: 当前身份没有执行该操作的权限。
